title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 46. Welcomes Türkiye’s efforts to diversify energy production and to reduce carbon emissions, also by making use of nuclear energy; notes that beyond the Akkuyu nuclear power plant, Türkiye has set ambitious nuclear energy targets in the switch to clean energy, with plans for additional full-scale nuclear plants and small modular reactors; highlights the need for a robust legal framework and stricter enforcement mechanisms to safeguard environmental and natural resources; encourages Türkiye to align its environmental policies with the EU acquis, including respecting natural habitats when conducting mining projects, and underlines the importance of Türkiye’s adherence to the Aarhus Convention; commends the work of environmental rights defenders in Türkiye and warns against the dire environmental impact of extensive government projects, such as the expansion of its copper mining activities in Mount Ida (Kaz Daglari);
